_comment: Predefined guided-study scenarios. Administrators may edit this file; the server re-reads it on each request. 'spec' uses the same fields as POST /api/guided/experiments. 'locked' lists fields participants cannot change when the scenario is used. Each scenario reproduces a configuration from the paper; none contains results.

scenarios.title: Paper case study: Email-Eu-core
scenarios.description: The paper's real-data case study (Section 7) with department-label communities: all six models, all five concepts, request sizes 10%, 25% and 50%.

scenarios.title: Paper case study: Decentraland
scenarios.description: The paper's projected co-voting case study (Section 7): the same 6 x 5 x 3 x 2 design, where Bridge Trend is expected to be invalid.

scenarios.title: Known truth: present versus history (RQ2)
scenarios.description: A synthetic decaying bridge. Bridge Trend edits history only, so a present-only model should not respond while trajectory models should.
